architecture_correction: Runtime liveness, recovery, service authority, virtual state and continuation are resident-system responsibilities. GitHub is source/history and optional external audit, not a runtime host dependency.

host_lineage.claim_boundary: The artifact is used as architectural host lineage; this binding record does not claim the notebook itself is currently executing.

service_authority_fabric.resident_role: domain ownership, zone intent, publication state and promotion ledger
authoritative zone/service object independent of public publication
mail/message intent, queue, identity, delivery evidence and retry state
service_authority_fabric.claim_boundary: Resident mail service state does not by itself prove external delivery.

service_authority_fabric.resident_role: network topology, route and node state

service_authority_fabric.state_carrier: scripted VFS/memory arrays and persisted runtime objects
service_authority_fabric.resident_role: logical state/memory/workspace substrate when physical/external actuator is absent

resolution_rule: For every subsystem resolve resident authority object -> VFS-backed state contract -> resident process/service -> optional external actuator. Absence of the final actuator must not erase the resident subsystem or make unrelated runtime liveness dependent on it.
resident_control_loop: run local hostile oracles on cadence
recover supervisor after exit or repeated health failure
preserve continuation state independently of GitHub Actions
retain virtual service state for unavailable external actuators
forbidden_substitutions: public DNS unavailable == private runtime unavailable
mail provider unavailable == mail service state nonexistent
HTTP response from stale process == current deployment generation verified
promotion_rule: Resident runtime claims require local process identity, health/readback, lifecycle proof and current-generation evidence. External publication/delivery claims additionally require their specific actuator receipts.
